dataset_info.notes: Projecte AINA LaFrescat — Catalan professional studio recordings (Lafresca Creative Studio voice actors) across four regional Catalan accents, 1429 rows, 'train' is the only split. Correction to the salvage audit's premise: this is NOT spontaneous speech, it's read/prepared-sentence studio recordings for TTS/ASR, per the dataset card. Registered anyway as a second, accent-diverse Catalan domain alongside festcat-ca-ES; both feed citrinet-512-ca and onnx-asr-conformer-transducer-ca.
